messages:
Zoe Kim: Quick announcement: effective next Monday (2026-05-05) Priya Natarajan will step in as interim Director, Private Deployments while we run a search for the permanent hire. She'll own Private product roadmap, compliance gating, and the on-prem rollout cadence. Expect a short org shuffle and two immediate backfills.

Priya Natarajan: Thanks Zoe. Happy to take this on. My priorities for the first 4 weeks: 1) stabilize customer on-prem intake backlog 2) complete the Private compliance checklist with Security 3) unblock two active pilots that need HW reservations. I'll be coordinating closely with Platform and Sales/CS.

Ravi Patel: Congrats Priya! For backfills we should add one Senior PM to cover product ops and one Senior SWE to support integration tests. I've drafted a short requisition for both and will post to hiring this afternoon.

Elena Gomez: Adding operations note: we'll also temporarily increase contractor coverage for install engineering (2x tech leads) through July. CS asked for clearer SLAs for pilot acceptance; Priya, can you confirm target response times so we update the onboarding checklist?

Priya Natarajan: Good call Elena. Target SLA for pilot intake: initial response within 24 hours, onboarding kickoff within 5 business days, and pilot readiness within 3 weeks unless we hit procurement blockers. I'll update the internal checklist doc and link it here once it's done.

Samir Shah: I'll own the SWE backfill hiring loop. Posting a short role brief now: Senior Integration Engineer (3+ yrs infra, TLS/KMS experience preferred, familiarity with VPC/private deployments). Will loop in Eng Talent and post to external channels.

HR-bot: ACTION: requisition created by Ravi Patel for Senior PM (req-4589) and by Samir Shah for Senior Integration Engineer (req-4590). Hiring timeline suggested: 6-8 weeks for interviews, 10-12 weeks to start.

Zoe Kim: Org notes: we'll keep direct reports the same for now; Priya will have dotted line to Security and CS leads for prioritization. We'll run a recruiter panel next Tue to align on candidate profiles. Also: small policy change — until backfills are onboarded, we allow 10% shift in project commitments for teams supporting Private to prevent burnout. Please work with your managers.

Priya Natarajan: I'll host a 30m sync next Tuesday 9am PT to walk through the backlog and the pilot SLAs. Invite will go out today. Appreciative of the quick support.

Elena Gomez: Noted. I'll adjust our pilot acceptance playbook and alert the SRE on-call for the next two weeks so we have extra eyes during handoffs.

Ravi Patel: I'll post the reqs to Greenhouse and ping senior recruiters. If anyone has candidate referrals DM me and I'll expedite.

Samir Shah: Signing off for now 44d. Congrats Priya and happy to help onboard the new hire when they arrive.

Zoe Kim: Thanks all 4aa. We'll treat this as a focused interim plan and reassess after the first 8 weeks.
